Treatment summary
The patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other driver was changing lanes,
reporting pain and swelling in the right knee. The mechanism described is consistent with the injury observed, and the
clinical picture fits what would be expected from a force of this kind. Examination findings and imaging clearly confirm
the knee injury, including soft tissue involvement that accounts for the patient's symptoms. The patient has a remote
history of a minor strain in the same area, which resolved completely with no lasting limitation and did not affect the
present evaluation. Care proceeded over 14 visits and followed a typical course, with frequency decreasing as
strength, range of motion, and pain improved. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no
duplicated or repeated charges. At the most recent visit the patient was progressing well and was discharged to a
self-directed home exercise program.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
